answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 505 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the zenith. The jade index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the vault queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
